title: Scan-copy completion configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite word, let $k$ be the number of work tapes, let $i$ be one of those tapes, and let $d$ be a machine configuration on input $x$. The resulting configuration retains all fields of $d$ except that its state is set to the completed phase and its work-tape contents are taken from the forward scan-copy construction run through the full word $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol alphabet and a set of machine states
A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A tape index $i$ among the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The forward scan-copy helper used to determine the work-tape contents is not included among the supplied definitions.
